items.title: Law firm Paul Weiss taps new Supreme Court practice head after Shanmugam exit
items.author: Sara Merken
items.creator: Sara Merken
items.summary: Law firm Paul Weiss has hired William Jay to lead its Supreme Court and appellate litigation practice, filling the role after the group's prominent head Kannon Shanmugam left for another firm earlier this year.
items.body:
Law firm Paul Weiss has hired William Jay to lead its Supreme Court and appellate litigation practice, filling the role after the group's prominent head Kannon Shanmugam left for another firm earlier this year.
Jay, who has argued 19 cases before the U.S. Supreme Court, joins Paul Weiss as a Washington, D.C.-based partner, the firm said on Monday. He has represented clients including Teva Pharmaceuticals, Varsity Brands and B&B Hardware.
Shanmugam, who previously led the Supreme Court practice at Paul Weiss, [USN:L6N4161HM TEXT:"departed"] with Masha Hansford in April to launch a new practice at law firm Davis Polk.
Jay practiced at Goodwin for 14 years. He previously worked as an assistant to the Solicitor General. Earlier in his career he was a clerk to former U.S. Supreme Court Justice Antonin Scalia.
Jay told Reuters that he was eager to join Paul Weiss as the New York firm grows its litigation department.
Paul Weiss has hired a handful of litigation partners this year, including former U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission deputy enforcement director Antonia Apps in February. The firm has also seen litigator departures, including a pair of partners who joined Linklaters in July.

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Harshita Mary Varghese　Casey Hall

[２４日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Harshita Mary Varghese　Casey Hall

[２４日　ロイター] - 中国発の格安電子商取引（ＥＣ）サイト「Ｔｅｍｕ（テム）」を運営するＰＤＤホールディングスが２４日発表した２０２６年４─６月期の決算は、売上高が前年同期比８％増の１１２３億５８００万元（１６５億６０００万ドル）だった。普通株主に帰属する純利益は１２％減の２７１億８２００万元で、競争激化や海外での規制強化の動きが響いた。

売上高は、ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリストの予想平均１１６３億５０００万元を下回った。米国預託株式（ＡＤＳ）１株当たりの調整後利益は１９．３３元と、予想を上回った。

雇用不安や不動産市場の低迷の長期化により、消費者は慎重な姿勢を維持。アリババや京東商城（ＪＤドットコム）を含めて中国ＥＣ業界全体で価格競争が激化し、各社の利益率を圧迫している。米国が小口貨物の関税免除を終了したことなどを受け、ここ数カ月間はＥＣの低価格品輸出が減少している。ＰＤＤは物流や出店者への支援策を拡充しており、投資家は収益性を巡る懸念を強めている。

ＰＤＤ幹部らは決算発表後のアナリスト向け電話会議で、中国のＥＣ市場での競争は「依然として激しい」と指摘。共同最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の陳磊氏は、多様な国際的な規制枠組みに対応することに苦慮していると吐露した。

欧州では中国の安価な商品の流入を抑制する取り組みが強化されている。欧州連合（ＥＵ）が７月に中国から直接輸入される小包に課した手数料は、販売業者と消費者のいずれにとってもコスト増となると見られている。

Aug 24 : U.S. Solheim Cup skipper Angela Stanford leaned heavily on experience by naming Megan Khang, Rose Zhang and Lindy Duncan as her three captain's picks on Monday for the team that will look to retain the trophy they took from Europe two years ago.
Khang will be competing in her fifth consecutive Solheim Cup, Zhang will wear the red, white and blue for a third time while Duncan, at 35 the oldest member in the squad, is making her debut in the biennial matchplay competition.
"Nothing can compare to the Solheim Cup ... putting on the red, white and blue is such an honor," Khang, who was top scorer for the U.S. at the 2023 Solheim Cup in Spain, said after being announced as the first of three captain's picks.
Duncan, who joins Auston Kim as one of two rookies on the U.S. team, had held the second qualifying spot via the world rankings for nearly two months before dropping out of position after The Standard Portland Classic in mid-August.

In addition to being the oldest member on the team, Duncan is the oldest debutant since Nancy Scranton played her first match aged 39 in 2000.
Zhang had arguably one of the most dominant performances in the history of the Solheim Cup in 2024 when she went 4-0-0 in matches that never made it to the 17th hole.
The trio joined automatic qualifiers Nelly Korda, Angel Yin, Jennifer Kupcho, Yealimi Noh, Auston Kim, Lauren Coughlin, Allisen Corpuz, Andrea Lee and Alison Lee on the U.S. team for the September 11 to 13 event at Bernardus Golf in the Netherlands.
The U.S. squad are looking to retain the Solheim Cup and secure their first away victory since the 2015 edition.

items.title: Hyundai Motor's union reaches tentative wage deal with management, Yonhap reports
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Hyundai Motor's South Korean union reached a tentative agreement with management on a 100,000 won ($72.31) monthly base salary increase, Yonhap News Agency reported on Tuesday.
items.body:
Hyundai Motor's (005380.KS) South Korean union reached a tentative agreement with management on a 100,000 won ($72.31) monthly base salary increase, Yonhap News Agency reported on Tuesday.
The deal comes after the union [USN:L1N44I02F TEXT:"staged its first full strike"] in a decade on Friday after wage talks stalled, as it sought a higher retirement age and job protections against artificial intelligence and automation.
According to the Yonhap report, the tentative agreement includes a base salary increase plus a performance bonus and welfare points.
From next year until 2028, 500 new technical workers will be hired, the report added.
Hyundai Motor did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment outside regular business hours.
Production at Hyundai's largest automobile factory in Ulsan city would have been suspended if the two sides had not reached a deal. The Ulsan plant has an annual capacity to produce about 1.5 million vehicles, accounting for roughly a quarter of Hyundai's total output.
The union had demanded the company set aside 30% of net income for bonuses and guarantee job security, raising concerns over growing adoption of robotics and artificial intelligence on assembly lines.
The world's third-largest automaker, which is also developing [USN:L1N43I027 TEXT:"humanoid robots"], appears to be planning to replace human workers with new technologies, a union leader said.
"We already see lots of robots deployed in the factories," Kim Jin-wook, head of external relations for Hyundai's union, told Reuters. "We are demanding management increase new hires, as the company is trying to reduce headcounts."
($1 = 1,382.8900 won)

items.title: Gold price rises, silver slips on Treasury cash-pile buyback signal
items.author: Scott Spence
items.creator: Scott Spence
items.summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent could tap a $935 billion cash pile to fund bond buybacks.
items.body:
Gold price rises, silver slips on Treasury cash-pile buyback signal

Scott Spence | August 24, 2026 | 10:50 am
Markets   USA   Gold   Silver  

Stock image.

Gold rose while silver slipped on Monday after CNBC reported that Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent could tap a $935 billion cash pile to fund bond buybacks, pushing long-term yields lower.

The department could draw on the Treasury General Account to fund buybacks of higher-yielding older securities, CNBC reported Monday, citing two senior Treasury officials.

The TGA, essentially the government’s checking account at the Federal Reserve, stood at $935 billion as of Aug. 20. Bessent called the operation a “Treasury Twist” in a CNBC interview, a reference to buying long-term bonds funded by short-term issuance.

The officials would not say how much, if any, of the TGA would be used. The report follows Bessent’s decision last week to double buybacks on the long end from $2 billion to at least $4 billion. Gold climbed 1.2% as of 12.30pm in New York, near a four-month high around $4,719 an ounce.

The 10-year Treasury yield fell as much as four basis points to 4.69%, and the all-important 30- year dropped to around 5.215%. Yields are slightly lower, however they remain near the levels that prompted the Treasury to intervene last week, when the 30-year touched a 19-year high above 5.27%.

Silver is down around 1% on the day, as price consolidates below the $70 resistance level. Silver has outrun gold in August, up almost 20% on the month vs gold’s 15%.

Copper gained a modest 0.46% and trades just below its all-time highs.

Another Band-aid

Monday’s Treasury move drew skepticism from Blake Gwinn, head of US rate strategy at RBC< Capital Markets, who called it “a very slapdash attempt to try to stem the selloff” and put the odds of the department actually using the cash at “very, very low,” Bloomberg reported.

The Treasury expanded its buyback program last week after long-dated yields hit multi-year highs, a move that provided only temporary relief as the 30-year yield erased the gains within a day. The week ahead will test investors, the Fed and the Treasury.

Fed Chair Kevin Warsh delivers his first Jackson Hole speech Friday, and July PCE data lands Wednesday, with economists surveyed by Bloomberg forecasting about 3.6% headline and 3.3% core year-over-year.

The Treasury will have it’s eyes firmly glued to long term rates.

(With files from Bloomberg)

items.title: 米国が新たな対イラン制裁、取引続ける国も対象－「経済版Dデー」
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： ベッセント米財務長官は24日、イランを世界経済から孤立させ6カ月近くに及ぶ戦争を終結させるため自ら「経済版Dデー」と呼ぶ作戦の一環として、イランと取引するあらゆる国に経済的な制裁を科すと警告した。

ベッセント氏はワシントンで開いた記者会見で、「われわれは世界各地に広がるイランの金融ネットワークに対し、経済的な猛攻撃を開始する」と表明。「イラン政権を経済的に窒息させるものだ」とし、イラン資金の洗浄に関与する場合、ドルへのアクセスを遮断すると述べた。

また、トランプ米大統領が各国首脳に電話し、「イラン政権との関係を停止するよう具体的に要請している」とも説明。各国にはイランとの関係を打ち切るための明確な期限が設定されており、従わなければ米財務省が単独で措置を講じる考えを示した。

今回の表明は、イランに屈服を迫る米国の最新の試みとなる。イランは数十年にわたり経済制裁を受け、2月下旬に始まった米国による爆撃が数カ月続いているにもかかわらず、米国の要求を拒み続けている。また、11月の中間選挙が近づく中、米国民の間で極めて不人気な戦争を終わらせようとするトランプ氏の焦りが強まっていることも浮き彫りになった。

今回の措置によってイランが世界経済や一部の貿易相手国からさらに孤立する可能性はあるが、イランに米国の要求を受け入れさせ、ホルムズ海峡の開放につなげられるかは不透明だ。

ベッセント氏の警告は、米国を中国との対立に向かわせるリスクもある。中国はイラン産原油の大半を購入しており、これまで購入停止を拒んできた。ベッセント氏は、イランの貿易相手国に直ちに制裁を科さない理由を問われると、こうした措置のリスクを認めた。

同氏は「われわれは全ての国に、不適切な行動を改める機会を与えている」と説明。「私が世界の金融システムを破壊したいと思うだろうか」と付け加えた。

米財務省は24日、60を超える団体への制裁を発表した。ベッセント氏は、イランにとって「最も重要な5つの生命線」に照準を合わせていると説明し、デジタル資産、テクノロジー、金、航空、海運を挙げた。さらに、イランとの関係を巡り、今週末までに大手金融機関1社を制裁対象にすると警告したが、対象の名前は明らかにしなかった。

items.title: 米、対イラン二次制裁を拡大　財務長官「経済的生命線断つ」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ワシントン ２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ワシントン ２４日 ロイター] - 米トランプ政権は２４日、新たな対イラン経済制裁を発表し、イランとのビジネス関係を維持する国や団体に対する二次制裁の対象を拡大した。イランとの戦争が約６カ月に及ぶ中、イランへの経済的圧力を強化する考えだ。一方で、二次制裁の対象となる国や発効時期などの詳細については明言を避けた。

ベセント財務長官は記者会見で、イランに対する「経済版Ｄデー」と呼ぶ措置について説明。「われわれは世界中のイランの金融ネットワークに対し、経済的な総攻撃を開始する」と表明し、「イラン政権を支えるあらゆる経済的生命線を断ち切ることが目的だ」と述べた。

さらに、米財務省はイランが石油の密輸や制裁回避に利用しているネットワークや仲介者、資金ルートを特定しており、米政府はパートナー国と協力し、イランの「違法な収入源」を全て標的にすると言明した。

米財務省の声明によると、イラン政府が経済を支えるために利用しているデジタル資産、テクノロジー、金、航空、海運の5分野が新たに二次制裁の対象に追加された。さらに、核、ミサイル、サイバー活動、石油取引などに絡み、約６０の団体、個人、船舶が制裁対象に指定された。

ベセント長官は「イランを支援する全ての国は、米国の制裁措置に直面する覚悟をしておくべきだ」と警告。しかし、イランの石油取引を助長した疑いのある中国の金融機関は今回の制裁対象に含まれていない。

中国はここ数年、イラン産原油の最大の購入国となっている。米国は中国による購入の抑制に向けた取り組みを強化しているものの、現時点では中国の大手銀行を制裁対象に指定するには至っていない。

items.title: US removes Syria from terrorism sponsor list, lifting major investment obstacle
items.author: Feras Dalatey
items.creator: Feras Dalatey
items.summary: The United States removed Syria from its list of state sponsors of terrorism on Monday, lifting what Damascus says was the last major impediment to investing in the country as Washington deepens ties to the new Syrian government.
items.body:
The United States removed Syria from its list of state sponsors of terrorism on Monday, lifting what Damascus says was the last major impediment to investing in the country as Washington deepens ties to the new Syrian government.
The removal, posted on the U.S. Treasury's website, took effect after a 45-day congressional review period triggered when Trump formally notified Congress on July 8 of his intention to rescind the designation.
“These actions were all taken in recognition of the positive actions taken and further commitments by the Syrian government under President Ahmed al-Sharaa to fully distance Syria from acts of international terrorism,” U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said in a statement.
Syrian Foreign Minister Asaad al-Shibani [USN:L8N44J06U TEXT:"told Reuters"] on Saturday that the government hoped removing what he called the "last obstacle" would help reconnect Syria to the global financial and economic system and boost investment. "There is no longer any obstacle to investment, doing business and rebuilding economic life in Syria," he said.
Syria had been on the list since 1979, when Washington accused the government of former President Hafez al-Assad of supporting militant groups. The designation remained throughout the rule of his son Bashar al-Assad, who was toppled by rebels led by current President Ahmed al-Sharaa in December 2024.
CUBA, IRAN, NORTH KOREA REMAIN Monday's announcement also removed the designation of the Nusrah Front as a Specially Designated Global Terrorist organization, leaving Cuba, Iran and North Korea as the three countries designated by Washington as state sponsors of terrorism.
The designation carries restrictions on U.S. foreign assistance, defense exports and sales, certain dual-use items and financial transactions, and had remained a major deterrent for banks and investors even after Washington dismantled its broader sanctions program on Syria.
Trump's administration terminated comprehensive U.S. sanctions on Syria in July 2025, while maintaining targeted sanctions against Assad and his associates, rights abusers, drug traffickers, Islamic State and al Qaeda affiliates and Iranian proxies.
The U.S. Treasury has since said American financial institutions can provide services to Syria, process payments involving Syrian banks and establish correspondent banking relationships with them, provided sanctioned parties are not involved.
But the terrorism designation remained a source of legal and compliance risk for firms considering entering Syria, whose government is seeking billions of dollars in investment to rebuild after nearly 14 years of war.
Signs of interest had grown ahead of the removal. Syria's finance ministry said this month that Finance Minister Mohammad Yisr Barnieh held talks with Bank of America (BAC.N) executives over potential cooperation and Syria's reintegration into the international financial system. Bank officials expressed willingness to visit Syria and continue discussions, according to the ministry.
Mastercard (MA.N) has gone further, announcing in May that it was working with QNB Group (QNBK.QA) and Syria's central bank to prepare infrastructure for international card payments in the country. The company has described itself as an early investor in Syria and said it wants to help connect Syrian consumers and businesses to global payment networks.
CONTINUED COOPERATION Trump notified Congress of his decision after meeting Sharaa in Ankara in July, telling the Syrian president in a letter seen by Reuters that he [USN:S0N3Y802F TEXT:"had promised"] to "remove all barriers" preventing Syria from rebuilding.
The delisting also followed months of negotiations between Damascus and Washington over Syria's economic and foreign policy.
Reuters [USN:L6N43U0ZX TEXT:"reported"] this month that Damascus agreed to drastically reduce imports of Russian oil during discussions with Washington over lifting the terrorism designation, according to three sources familiar with the talks.
Trump has increasingly embraced Sharaa, the former commander of al Qaeda's Nusra Front who broke ties with the global jihadist network in 2016 and led the rebel coalition that overthrew Assad.
Washington has praised cooperation by Sharaa's government against Islamic State and said easing restrictions is intended to give Syria an opportunity to stabilise, attract investment and rebuild.

Trump bought shares in Elon Musk's SpaceX in June, financial disclosure shows

WASHINGTON, Aug 24 : U.S. President Donald Trump invested as much as $50,000 in Elon Musk's SpaceX in June, according to a public financial disclosure, giving him a financial stake in a major government contractor run by his former adviser. 
He bought between $15,001 and $50,000 in shares on June 23, according to a financial disclosure signed by him on August 12 and made public on August 22. The purchase was part of more than 1,000 stock trades the president made in June.
SpaceX priced the biggest-ever U.S. IPO on June 12, valuing the space, satellite and AI provider at $1.77 trillion.
In a statement to Reuters, White House spokesman Davis Ingle said that third-party financial institutions independently manage the president's portfolio and replicate "recognized indexes, such as the Schwab 1000."

"Neither President Trump nor any member of his family has any ability to direct, influence or provide input regarding how the portfolio is invested or when investments are bought or sold," Ingle said in the statement. 
Trump's investment in SpaceX adds a new financial link between the president and Musk's rocket company at a time when the administration is making decisions that could affect the firm's fortunes. 
SpaceX is a U.S. military contractor, and often seeks approvals from federal agencies. Trump on Thursday directed his team to help drastically increase the number of U.S. commercial space launches. SpaceX is a dominant player in that sector. 
U.S. Small Business Administration leader and Trump cabinet member Kelly Loeffler earned millions from SpaceX's IPO, Reuters previously reported. Loeffler first invested in xAI, Musk’s AI and social media firm that has since merged with SpaceX. She invested again after Trump nominated her to lead the SBA. 
Her first investment in xAI would have been worth between $7 million and $2.6 billion on the day of the IPO, depending on the exact amount she invested and the date she made it, said Franco Granda, analyst at data provider PitchBook. The second investment would have been worth between $2.2 million and $25.4 million that day, he said.
Reuters could not immediately determine the precise amount of Trump's investment because federal officials use ranges to declare the value of their assets on their financial disclosure forms.

items.title: Israeli fire kills two young children in Gaza, medics say
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Israeli airstrikes and gunfire killed two young children and at least two other Palestinians in the Gaza Strip on Monday, health officials in the territory said.
items.body:
Israeli airstrikes and gunfire killed two young children and at least two other Palestinians in the Gaza Strip on Monday, health officials in the territory said.
Medics and relatives said 10-year-old Amal Abu Khater was hit by a bullet in her back while she was eating inside her family's tent in the enclave's southern city of Khan Younis. The fire came from Israeli forces to the east, they added.
The Israeli military said it was not aware of any incident involving a 10-year-old girl.
A four-year-old boy and another Palestinian were killed in separate Israeli airstrikes on a house in Bureij refugee camp and a road in Khan Younis, medics said.
Earlier on Monday, another Israeli airstrike killed one person and wounded another at a tent in Deir Al-Balah in the central Gaza Strip, medics said.
The Israeli military said that strike in Deir Al-Balah targeted a Hamas militant, but did not specifically respond to questions about the other two reported attacks in Khan Younis and Bureij.
More than 1,280 Palestinians have been killed in Gaza since a ceasefire took effect last October , according to Gazan health officials, while the Israeli military says four Israeli soldiers have been killed.
Hamas accuses Israel of violating the ceasefire and undermining efforts to implement a broader plan by U.S. President Donald Trump to end the Gaza conflict, which also includes Israeli withdrawals and Hamas disarmament.
Israel says its strikes aimed to thwart imminent attacks by Hamas and other Gaza militants.
The Israeli military issued two separate evacuation orders in Beach refugee camp and Deir Al-Balah in northern and central Gaza Strip before it carried out airstrikes in the two areas, without reports of casualties, residents and medics said.
It also bombed a desalination plant in the Sheikh Radwan neighbourhood in Gaza City, at a time when the enclave is suffering water shortages, residents and Hamas said.
An Israeli military spokesperson said the military had carried out strikes on several Hamas weapons storage sites throughout the day, including two inside mosques.
The spokesperson said that among the sites targeted on Monday was one located adjacent to a desalination facility.
The spokesperson said the military had not targeted the desalination facility and did not say whether or not it had been damaged in the strike.

LONDON: Britain said on Monday (Aug 24) it had signed a partnership with Ukraine to jointly develop artificial intelligence tools for defence and security, giving British researchers access to a Ukrainian battlefield data platform used to train military AI systems.
Prime Minister Andy Burnham and President Volodymyr Zelenskyy signed the agreement in Kyiv, making Britain the first international partner to access Ukraine's Avengers AI Labs, a government statement said.
Avengers Labs was built around an annotated dataset of 5 million battlefield images, Ukraine's Defence Ministry said earlier in August, largely drawn from the military's DELTA combat system - a domestically developed battlefield management and situational-awareness system.
The platform uses data collected from cameras and sensors across Ukraine's battlefield, including information on tanks, artillery systems, drones and other military targets.

The Ukrainian ministry said AI models trained on the data were already being used in an automated target-detection system that analyses more than 100,000 drone video feeds each month and can identify about 70 per cent of enemy targets in real time.
Under the deal, Britain and Ukraine will collaborate on pilot projects including technology that uses fibre-optic cables as AI-enabled sensors to help protect military facilities, and research into low-power AI chips for drones and autonomous systems.
The British government said the partnership would initially focus on defence and national security projects bringing together researchers, engineers, technology companies and military experts from both countries.
Burnham on Monday visited Ukraine for his first trip abroad since becoming prime minister, where he had talks with Zelenskyy and co-chaired a meeting of the "Coalition of the Willing."
His office had earlier announced Britain would allow missile maker MBDA to release classified information on British-made components used in the SCALP long-range cruise missile to help establish assembly lines in Ukraine.

items.title: 米韓外相が電話会談、緊密な連携維持確認　北朝鮮核問題など協議
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２５日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[２５日 ロイター] - ルビオ米国務長官は２４日、韓国の趙顕外相と電話会談し、両国の同盟に不可欠な問題について緊密な連携を維持する必要性を確認した。米国務省が明らかにした。

聯合ニュースは韓国外務省の話として、両外相は北朝鮮の核問題や朝鮮半島の平和維持に向け、緊密な意思疎通と協力を継続することで一致したと報じた。また聯合ニュースによると、韓国外務省は会談に関する声明で、北朝鮮の核問題を巡る協力の重要性を強調したものの、両氏がこれまで通り北朝鮮の非核化に対する関与を再確認したかどうかについては言及しなかった。

国務省のピゴット報道官は声明で、両氏が米韓同盟における幅広い議題について協議したと説明した。

今回の会談は、同盟国間の緊張が高まる中で行われた。トランプ米大統領は１６日、北朝鮮の金正恩朝鮮労働党総書記との「非常に良好な関係」を理由に韓国軍との合同演習を短縮するよう国防総省（ペンタゴン）当局者に指示した。

items.title: 中国国家主席、7年ぶりインド訪問へ　ＢＲＩＣＳ首脳会議に大規模代表団
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Saurabh Sharma　Aftab Ahmed

[ニューデリー ２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Saurabh Sharma　Aftab Ahmed

[ニューデリー ２４日 ロイター] - 中国の習近平国家主席が、９月にインドで開催される新興国グループ「ＢＲＩＣＳ」首脳会議に大規模な代表団を率いて出席する見通しだと、関係者３人が明らかにした。実現すれば７年ぶりの訪問となり、中国とインドの関係改善につながる可能性がある。

ＢＲＩＣＳ首脳会議は９月１２、１３両日にニューデリーで開催。２０２０年の両国国境付近での衝突を受けて悪化した関係の修復につながるかどうかが注目される。トランプ米政権の通商政策を踏まえ、ＢＲＩＣＳ諸国の経済への悪影響を抑えたい意向とみられる。

インド関係者の１人はロイターに「中国当局者は、宿泊や警備体制の最終調整をしている」と述べた。関係者２人によると、約４００人の中国当局者が同行する見通し。１９年の前回訪問時は２００人未満だった。

関係者らによると、両国の当局者らは首脳による協議で、国境や地域の安全保障問題を巡る長年の対立を調整しつつ、関係拡大へ向けた方法を模索するとみられる。習氏の最終的な訪問計画や二国間会談に関する議題などは未確定という。

インドのモディ首相は昨年、７年ぶりに中国を訪問したものの、両国関係に大きな改善は見られていない。インドのアジト・ドバル国家安全保障顧問は２４日から訪中し、王毅外相と国境問題に関して協議する見通しだ。

中国外務省は「今年のＢＲＩＣＳ首脳会議が成功するよう支援する」とした上で、習氏の訪問に関して「現時点で提供できる情報はない」と述べた。２５年にブラジルで開かれた前回のＢＲＩＣＳサミットでは、習氏は出席を見送っていた。

China's Xi likely to visit India with big delegation for first time in seven years

India-China relations have remained strained for years, largely due to ongoing border tensions and territorial disputes.

Chinese President Xi Jinping and Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi meet on the sidelines of the BRICS summit in Kazan, Russia, on Oct 23, 2024. (Photo: REUTERS/China Daily)

FAST

NEW DELHI: Chinese President Xi Jinping is likely to attend next month's BRICS summit in New Delhi with a large delegation , three sources said, in what would be his first visit in seven years and a fresh sign of a thaw between the rivals.
India is hosting the Sep 12 to 13 summit, where Xi 's presence would be watched less for the BRICS agenda than for what it signals about Beijing and New Delhi's efforts to stabilise relations after deadly border clashes in 2020 .
"Chinese officials are busy finalising hotels and security protocols," one of the India n sources with direct knowledge told Reuters.
Last year, India n Prime Minister Narendra Modi visit ed China for the first time in seven years , but the relationship has only improved gradually. More recently, a fresh border-related dispute triggered sharp diplomatic exchanges between the two sides.

Two other India n sources said Xi was likely to be accompanied by a delegation of about 400 officials, compared with fewer than 200 officials the last time in 2019.
Officials from both countries are expected to use the summit to explore ways to expand engagement while managing long-standing differences over the border and regional security issues, the sources added.
Xi 's final travel plans and agenda for any potential bilateral between India and China are yet to be finalised , the sources said.
The Chinese foreign ministry said, "China attaches great importance to and actively participates in BRICS cooperation, and supports India , the current chair, in successfully hosting this year's BRICS summit."
"We currently have no information available to provide" about Xi 's visit , it said. Xi missed the last BRICS summit in 2025 in Brazil.
India 's foreign ministry did not comment.

INDIA -CHINA BORDER ISSUE The world's two most populous nations, both nuclear powers, share a roughly 3,800-km (2,400-mile), largely undemarcated and disputed border in the Himalayas.
Decades of relative peace along the border were shattered by 2020 clashes where 20 India n and four Chinese soldiers were killed. The incident led to a four-year military standoff before reaching a disengagement pact in October 2024.
But on Aug 12, India said peace along the border was critical to ties after reports that India n and Chinese army patrols came face-to-face in late July near a remote border.
India 's National Security Advisor Ajit Doval on Monday (Aug 24) started his visit to Beijing to meet Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi to hold talks on the boundary issue.
While India and China remain competitors, US President Donald Trump's trade policies have created one area of convergence, making Xi 's attendance a signal that neither side wants external pressure to undermine BRICS.

items.title: LinkedIn Users Are Rewriting the Past to Land Jobs
items.summary:
Researchers at Stanford University and Revelio Labs found that nearly 20% of established US LinkedIn users edited the descriptions or titles of jobs they had left years earlier, with tech workers doing so at a rate of nearly one in three.
These changes, dubbed "time travel," aren't made while memories are still fresh, but instead reflect a change in personal branding, with the median time-travel edit occurring more than four years after the user left the role. Beth Kowitt, Bloomberg Opinion Columnist covering corporate America joined Bloomberg Intelligence to discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: メキシコが2年ぶりにサムライ債の発行計画、最大6本－関係者
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： メキシコは今週、2024年以来2年ぶりとなるサムライ債の発行を計画している。事情に詳しい関係者が明らかにした。

関係者によると、メキシコは年限3.5－20年の円建て債を最大6本発行する方向で調整している。28日に条件決定を予定しており、需要や市場環境によっては一部の年限の発行を見送る可能性がある。債券の初期価格交渉では、年限に応じてTONARミッドスワップに100－200ベーシスポイント（bp、1bp＝0.01%）上乗せした水準になる見通しだという。

メキシコ政府が前回サムライ債を発行したのは2024年8月で、5本発行し計1522億円を調達した。メキシコは1年半－2年おきにサムライ債を発行しており、今回もこれまでの発行ペースに沿ったものとなる。

メキシコの信用格付けには下押し圧力がかかっている。S&Pグローバル・レーティングは5月、財政状況の低迷が長引いていることや債務水準の上昇、経済成長の弱さを理由に、メキシコの格付け見通しを「ネガティブ」に変更した。ムーディーズ・レーティングスも5月に同様の懸念を示し、メキシコの格付けを投資適格級で最低の水準に引き下げた。国営のメキシコ石油公社（ペメックス）への継続的な支援が、政府の債務抑制能力を制約しているとしている。

メキシコは通商面でも不安定な状況にある。米国は7月、カナダ、メキシコとの米国・メキシコ・カナダ協定（USMCA）を更新せず、代わりに毎年見直す方針を示した。

その後、米国とカナダの交渉は21日に決裂した。合意案の文言が、カナダ側が合意したと認識していた内容と食い違う点が複数あったためだ。このため、メキシコと米国の協議の行方にも懸念が生じている。

items.title: Gang attack on hillside town near Haiti's capital leaves 30 dead
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: At least 30 people were killed in a gang raid in the neighborhood of Kenscoff near Haiti's capital of Port-au-Prince, Kenscoff's mayor Jean Massillon told Reuters on Monday.
items.body:
At least 30 people were killed in a gang raid in the neighborhood of Kenscoff near Haiti's capital of Port-au-Prince, Kenscoff's mayor Jean Massillon told Reuters on Monday.
Kenscoff is a hillside town overlooking Port-au-Prince has seen frequent gang attacks over the last couple of years. Rights groups have reported mass killings, rapes, arson and kidnappings, forcing thousands to flee their homes.
Haitian rights group RNDDH estimated 30 to 40 people had been killed and 15 to 20 wounded in the overnight raid, which began around 10:30 p.m. local time (0230 GMT), but warned it was still difficult to assess a complete tally.
Haiti's prime minister's office on Monday afternoon decried the "heinous attack", noting all security forces were on high alert and reinforcements were being deployed.
"Kenscoff will not be abandoned," it said in a statement. "The government's authority will be restored, without weakness and without delay, throughout all of Kenscoff."
Haiti's national police did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
The community occupies a strategic position overlooking routes into Petion-Ville - home to several embassies, upscale hotels and the temporary seat of government - as well as routes from the capital into southern parts of the country.
Local media said several houses were set on fire, including the home of Jean William Pape, a leading public health expert in Haiti.
The attack occurred as the U.N.-backed Gang Suppression Force, which is mandated to help police fight gangs and replace an underfunded and ineffectual predecessor, plans to reach a full capacity of more than 5,500 troops by fall this year.

items.title: 再送-EXCLUSIVE-政府、非中核事業の売却益で課税繰り延べ検討　事業再編を促進＝関係者
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Miho Uranaka　Makiko Yamazaki

[東京 ２５日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Miho Uranaka　Makiko Yamazaki

[東京 ２５日 ロイター] - 政府は、企業が非中核事業の売却益を成長事業の買収に充てることを条件に、課税を無期限に先送りできる新しい税制の導入を検討している。事情に詳しい複数の関係者が明らかにした。８月末の税制改正要望への盛り込みを経て、年末に策定する２０２７年度税制改正大綱への反映を目指す。企業の事業ポートフォリオの組み替えや成長投資を促すのが狙いで、長年滞っていた企業の事業再編が加速する可能性がある。

関係者によると、この案では、企業が子会社の株式や事業の売却により得た資金を数年以内に中核事業に関連する買収へ再投資し、さらに買収後の事業への投資も確約することを条件に、売却益にかかる約３０％の法人税を無期限に繰り延べることができる。買収後の再投資は、賃上げや設備投資などの成長投資も条件となる見通し。売却から買収までの期間など、詳細は今後詰める。

売却益への課税は次の買収に回せる資金を目減りさせ、事業入れ替えの足かせとなっていた。政府は、企業が低収益事業を売却し得られた資金を中核事業の強化に回す循環をつくりたい考えで、高市早苗首相が進めるガバナンス改革を加速させる上でも重要な施策の一つとなる可能性がある。

背景には、多くの企業が低収益事業を抱え続け、資本を成長分野に振り向けられていないとの政府の問題意識がある。経済産業省のデータによると、投下資本のうち資本コストを上回る価値を生む部門への配分は３５％にとどまる。２０２０年の報告書では、日本企業は事業売却の基準を持たず、規模や雇用の安定を優先してきたと指摘している。

政府はこれまでもスピンオフ税制（１７年）やパーシャル・スピンオフ税制（２３年）など企業再編を後押しする措置を導入したが、活用実績は限られている。今回の案は、２０００年代初頭にドイツで実施され、株式売却益の原則非課税化で企業の持ち合い解消と事業再編を促した税制改革を参考にした。

政府はコーポレート・ガバナンス改革を通じ、企業に事業ポートフォリオの見直しや経営資源の配分について、具体的な説明と継続的な検証を求めている。同時に事業ポートフォリオの改善や事業再編を促す「強力なインセンティブ措置」を検討するとしていた。今回の税制は、こうした改革の中核をなす施策と位置付けられる。

日本のＭ＆Ａ（合併・買収）件数は過去最高水準に達する一方、資本や人材が生産性の高い企業へ移る質的な再編は進んでいない。ロンドン証券取引所グループ（ＬＳＥＧ）によると、昨年、日本企業が関与したＭ＆Ａ総額は前年比２倍超の約３５２９億ドルで過去最高となり、このうち日本企業による事業売却は４４７億ドルだった。

items.title: SBI flags 'chalk and cheese' divide in RBI's monetary policy signals
items.author: Anjali Kumari
items.summary: SBI Research says the MPC minutes carried a more hawkish tone than the RBI governor's remarks, leaving markets uncertain about the future course of interest rates ...
items.body: The Reserve Bank of India’s (RBI’s) recent policy communications have sent conflicting signals on the future course of interest rates, according to the latest report by the State Bank of India (SBI).   The report compared the minutes of the Monetary Policy Committee’s (MPC’s) August meeting, the accompanying monetary policy statement, and RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra’s public remarks, and found the three documents diverging in tone. Soumya Kanti Ghosh, group chief economic adviser at the bank, noted that the MPC minutes carried a distinctly hawkish undertone, dwelling on inflation risks and keeping the door open for further rate action. “The recent monetary policy minutes, monetary policy press statement and the governor’s statement for August and even earlier months reveal the conundrum of ‘chalk and cheese’ in monetary policy. There were clear yet divergent signals from these three statements despite originating from the same institution/source,” Ghosh said while noting a “communication puzzle” emerging from the RBI’s latest policy cycle. The governor’s statement, by comparison, struck a calmer, more data-dependent note, giving more weight to the growth momentum and financial-sector conditions than to inflation risk. To capture this gap, the bank has built a tone index using the governor’s statement as a baseline of 1. On that scale, the MPC minutes scored 1.76 in June and 1.82 in August (a reading more than 1 signalling greater hawkishness). The widest gaps between the two showed up specifically in discussions of rates and the policy stance, and in the treatment of inflation, the report said. That split, according to the report, has left markets guessing whether to price in a rate increase in October or to take the governor’s cautious tone as the guide to the regulator’s next move. SBI Research said the window for an increase had technically opened but that the decision remained delicately poised, pointing to two broad sources of uncertainty. The MPC kept the repo rate unchanged at 5.25 per cent for the fourth meeting in a row while maintaining the “neutral” stance. On the external front, the report flagged resilient but fragile growth in the United States (US), buoyed by consumer spending and artificial intelligence-related investment, but shadowed by a surprise contraction in non-farm payrolls and a national debt, which has now crossed $40 trillion. It noted that the US Treasury’s decision to at least double its bond buyback size made a near-term rate increase in the US look unlikely even as the move raised the prospects of the Fed eventually stepping in with more direct intervention. The report pointed to an uneven and underwhelming monsoon in India as a bigger worry. Despite an overall shortfall of only around 13 per cent, key foodgrain-producing states such as Bihar, Andhra Pradesh, Punjab and Karnataka are running large deficits, and forecaster Skymet has since cut its seasonal outlook and raised the probability of drought conditions. Against this backdrop, the report has argued that addressing rural distress, including through the newly launched rural employment-guarantee scheme, which has so far seen a sharp fall in person-days generated compared with its predecessor, should take precedence over tightening monetary policy. Pursuing an expansionary push in rural spending alongside a rate increase, the report cautioned, would be difficult to reconcile.

FAST

TOKYO, Aug 25 : Japan's government is considering tax breaks on gains from sales of non-core businesses, a move that could accelerate long-delayed corporate restructuring and spur industry consolidation, two people with knowledge of the matter said.
The plan would remove a major obstacle to companies shedding non-core businesses and redeploying capital into growth areas, in what could become one of Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi's most significant initiatives to advance corporate governance reform.
Under the plan, roughly 30 per cent corporate tax on gains from sales of non-core businesses would be deferred indefinitely, provided companies reinvest the proceeds within several years in acquisitions aligned with their core operations and commit to investing in those businesses, one of the sources said.
The proposal is expected to be submitted as part of tax reform requests due at the end of this month, with details to be worked out before a final tax reform package for the next fiscal year is approved at year-end, said one of the sources, who declined to be identified as the matter is still private.

POOR CAPITAL ALLOCATION
The initiative is modelled on Germany's tax reform in the early 2000s, which largely exempted corporations from taxes on gains from share disposals, helping dismantle the country's dense network of cross-shareholdings and making it easier for companies to reshape their business portfolios.
Non-core businesses often remain trapped within sprawling Japanese conglomerates because gains from divestitures are taxed, reducing the incentive to transfer assets to owners better positioned to extract value from them.
The result is often inefficient capital allocation. A recent government study found that about 65 per cent of Japanese companies' invested capital remains tied up in businesses that fail to earn their cost of capital, largely offsetting value created by higher-performing units.
Such capital trapped in low-return operations is seen as limiting growth investment and weighing on long-term corporate value.
Japan has already introduced a range of measures to promote business overhauls over the years, including spin-off tax rules in 2017 and a partial spin-off regime in 2023, but business divestitures taking advantage of those rules have remained relatively limited.
A 2020 industry ministry report showed Japanese companies often lack clear divestment criteria and have traditionally prioritised maintaining group size, employment and corporate stability over portfolio reshaping.
The tax reform, if implemented, is likely to boost already sizzling M&A activity in Japan.
Deal activity involving Japanese companies last year more than doubled from the previous year to a record $353 billion, according to LSEG. Divestitures of Japanese businesses accounted for $44.7 billion of that total.  

Source: Reuters

items.title: 足元の債券利回り急上昇、「トランプ氏のイラン戦争」の結果＝独財務相
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Maria Martinez

[ベルリン ２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Maria Martinez

[ベルリン ２４日 ロイター] - ドイツのクリンバイル財務相は２４日、最近の債券利回りの急上昇はトランプ米大統領による「イラン戦争」の結果だとの認識を示した。リヒテンシュタインのシャーンで開かれた記者会見で述べた。

クリンバイル氏はドイツ語圏諸国の他の財務相らと行った会見で、「ここ数日、数週間にわたる利回りの上昇は、トランプ氏のイラン戦争によって引き起こされた世界的な不確実性の結果だ」と述べた。

ドイツの３０年国債利回りは先週、２０１１年以来の高水準となる３．７９％を記録。米３０年債利回りは１８日、５．３２１％に達し、０７年以来の高水準を付けた。イラン戦争に伴うインフレ懸念は、国債の売り圧力に拍車をかけている。

こうした中、関係筋は２４日、ロイターに対し、米政府は各国に対し、イランとの関係を断たなければ、ドル建て金融システムから自国の企業が排除される恐れがあると警告する方針だと明らかにした。

items.title: 米国が中国製品に7.5%関税へ､過剰生産能力で－9月の米中首脳会談前に
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米国は中国の過剰生産能力を問題視し、中国製品に対して7.5%の関税を課す見通しだ。事情に詳しい複数の関係者が明らかにしたもので、来月予定されるトランプ米大統領と中国の習近平国家主席との会談を前に導入する方向だ。

今回の措置により、トランプ政権2期目に導入される対中関税は約20%に戻ることになる。これとは別に、トランプ政権1期目に導入され、バイデン政権下でも継続された関税も課されている。

匿名を条件に語った同関係者によれば、具体的な税率は最終決定されたわけではない。トランプ氏は通商政策の発表に関し、最終段階で新たな要求を突き付ける、あるいは内容を変更するといった手法を採ることで知られる。

検討されている案の一つは、より高い対中関税率を発表した上で、その適用を一部停止し、実効税率を7.5%にするものだという。

どの税率をどの程度の期間、適用停止とするか、詳細はなお協議中だと関係者は語った。

トランプ政権は今年3月、過剰生産能力を巡る懸念を理由に、1974年通商法301条に基づき、主要な貿易相手国・地域を対象に調査を開始した。

原題：US Eyes China Overcapacity Tariffs of 7.5% Before Xi-Trump Talks（抜粋）

items.title: India, China Walk a Delicate Borderline in Preparation for BRICS Summit
items.author: Arthur Kaufman
items.creator: Arthur Kaufman
items.summary: India’s National Security Advisor Ajit Doval is visiting Beijing on Monday and Tuesday  this week and will meet Wang Yi as part of the 25th round of talks between each country’s Special Representatives on the border issue. The visit comes a few weeks before a …
items.summary_source: The China-Global South Project source metadata
items.body:
India’s National Security Advisor Ajit Doval is visiting Beijing on Monday and Tuesday  this week and will meet Wang Yi as part of the 25th round of talks between each country’s Special Representatives on the border issue.

The visit comes a few weeks before a BRICS summit in New Delhi on September 12 and 13 that Xi Jinping is expected to attend. It would mark Xi’s first visit to India in seven years and potentially confirm the thaw in relations between India and China.

However, recent news related to their border has complicated  efforts to improve the bilateral relationship .

On August 7,  New Delhi published a controversial new map  that renamed 27 locations in Arunachal Pradesh, referred to as Zangnan or South Tibet by the Chinese, along the Line of Actual Control. This occurred just one day after a meeting between officials from both sides under the Working Mechanism for Consultation and Coordination on border affairs.

The South China Morning Post also published an article on Sunday highlighting  China’s plans to build a vast, 25,000-kilometer “national ring road” along its borders , including the southwestern G219 highway whose upgrades and extensions are taking place in areas disputed by New Delhi.

Despite pushing for warmer relations, India is also seeking to increase its economic independence from China in certain areas. Reuters reported last Friday that, according to government sources,  India is set to approve a $1.2 billion incentive scheme  for producing high-value construction and infrastructure equipment to reduce dependence on China for critical machinery. 

In other news, a cargo ship carrying 24 crew members, 20 of whom are Chinese nationals,  sank off of India’s eastern coast on Sunday . India’s coastguard has so far rescued two Chinese nationals as search-and-rescue operations continue.

WHY IS THIS IMPORTANT?  The Indian and Chinese governments are trying to maintain a delicate diplomatic balancing act. Their move toward better diplomatic ties and a successful BRICS summit with Xi’s attendance requires toning down longstanding disagreements over border issues, while not appearing to capitulate to the other side in the eyes of their respective domestic constituents.

items.title: 米トランプ政権、専門職ビザ手数料10万ドル超へ　規制案公表
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Daniel Wiessner

[２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Daniel Wiessner

[２４日 ロイター] - トランプ米政権は２４日、専門技能を持つ外国人労働者向け就労ビザ「Ｈ－１Ｂ」の申請手数料を約１０万ドルとする措置を法制化するための規制案を公表した。

トランプ大統領は昨年９月、移民取り締まり強化の一環として、同ビザの手数料引き上げに向けた大統領布告に署名。従来の手数料である約２０００─５０００ドルから１０万ドル超へと大幅に引き上げる内容。

ただ、連邦地裁は６月、議会の承認を得ていない違法な課税に当たるとして、無効とする判断を示し、その後控訴審での審理が続いている。

布告は９月に失効するものの、国土安全保障省に手数料増額を恒久化するための規則を制定するよう指示していた。

同省がオンライン官報に掲載した規制案によると、手数料は１０万３２６５ドルに引き上げられ、２５日に正式に公表される。その後、３０日間のパブリックコメント期間を経て、年末までに最終決定される可能性がある。

items.title: Browns to open season with Deshaun Watson as QB1
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: New Browns head coach Todd Monken opted to stay the course in Cleveland and will start Deshaun Watson at quarterback in Week 1 of the regular season.
items.body:
New Browns head coach Todd Monken opted to stay the course in Cleveland and will start Deshaun Watson at quarterback in Week 1 of the regular season.
"Took in the full body of work over the course of offseason to training camp to the games and the joint practice, and ultimately, felt like to start the season on the road, Deshaun gave us the best chance to move the ball and score points," Monken said Monday. "And that's really what it's about. I felt that way going into the last game, but wasn't sure. And after we talked as a staff and after we re-looked at everything, we're going to let it rip."
Watson and Shedeur Sanders competed for the starting job in training camp, rotating reps with the first-team offense in practice and preseason games.
The Browns begin the 2026 regular season with two road games: Sept. 13 at the Jacksonville Jaguars and the following week at Tampa Bay. Cleveland's first home game is Sept. 27 against the Carolina Panthers.
Despite reports the Browns were considering holding Sanders in the backup role until the home opener, Monken said Monday he's not entering into a "week-to-week thing" and expects Watson to excel.
"Again, I think Shedeur has done a great job, come a long ways, and we're excited about his future. But this is not a week-to-week decision," he said.
Cleveland covets stability at the position, and Watson was viewed as the potential answer when he was acquired from the Houston Texans prior to the 2022 season. As part of the trade, Watson signed a five-year, $230 million contract. But after starting his tenure with the team serving a suspension, he has been hindered by injuries and is just 9-10 as a starter in Cleveland. He hasn't played more than seven games in any of his four seasons with the Browns.
Watson did not play last season while recovering from two surgeries to repair his Achilles. Watson tore his right Achilles tendon in October 2024 and a recurrence of the same injury during rehab prompted a second operation.
Sanders, a fifth-round pick in 2025, was thrown into the lineup as a rookie. With Watson on injured reserve all season, the Browns began the season with Joe Flacco as the starter but traded him to the Cincinnati Bengals. Dillon Gabriel, a third-round rookie in 2025, was named the starter but Sanders took over in November. He had seven touchdown passes and 10 interceptions in eight games.
Watson likely needs a strong start to the regular season to win back a fan base that appears to be running out of patience. Watson was showered with boos by home fans during Saturday's preseason game and said it was "personal." He played the second half against Buffalo and completed 5 of 12 passes for 36 yards and an interception
"It's a little bit (more) personal than that. So I think it's a disrespectful thing," Watson said of being booed at home. "So yeah, I mean, I'm going to keep whatever I feel with me and my family internally on how I feel about that. And yeah, just move on."
Watson, who turns 31 the day after the Week 1 opener, used time with the media Monday to walk back some of his views on Browns fans.
"... I think my emotions got the best of me," Watson said. "My comments wasn't intended to go at any of the fans around the city, because there's been a lot of great fans that have been supporting me."
Monken, hired to replace Kevin Stefanski, is a first-time head coach after serving as the Baltimore Ravens' offensive coordinator for the last three seasons. He said Watson and the Browns can avoid being booed at home by playing better, but also offered his perspective on Watson's response.
"I see the competitor in him. I see the everyday work he puts in, and he wants to be back," Monken said. "He wants to get back to where he was as best he can, and that's hard. And again, I think the moment just got him after the game, and it can get all of us."
--Field Level Media

items.title: Monedas caen en medio de cautela de mercados a la espera de datos y Fed
items.author: Manuel Farías
items.creator: Manuel Farías
items.summary: Las principales monedas de América Latina iniciaron la semana con bajas, en medio de la cautela que ronda los mercados en una semana en la que se esperan datos y presentaciones de banqueros centrales que puedan dar orientación sobre el futuro de las tasas de interés en Estados Unidos.
items.body:
Las principales monedas de América Latina iniciaron la semana con bajas, en medio de la cautela que ronda los mercados en una semana en la que se esperan datos y presentaciones de banqueros centrales que puedan dar orientación sobre el futuro de las tasas de interés en Estados Unidos.
* La mirada, además, seguía puesta en la evolución de los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro, cuya alza de las últimas semanas ha generado preocupaciones sobre los costos del endeudamiento.
* La cautela en las monedas era también generada por los acontecimientos sobre Oriente Medio, luego de que el secretario del Tesoro, Scott Bessent, anunció una ampliación de las sanciones secundarias que puede imponer a entidades y países que mantengan vínculos comerciales con Irán en todo el mundo.
* El dólar avanzó a nivel global tras la ampliación de las sanciones contra Irán y la imposición de aranceles adicionales a los productos procedentes de Canadá.
* La semana también estará marcada por los comentarios del presidente de la Reserva Federal, Kevin Warsh, en el simposio de Jackson Hole, sobre la orientación de las tasas de interés.
* El peso mayorista argentino se depreció un 0,66% al nivel mínimo histórico en 1.510 por cada dólar, su nivel mínimo histórico. El banco central (BCRA) argentino acumuló compras por 11 millones de dólares con el inicio de esta semana.
* "El dólar mayorista quebró la barrera de los 1.500 (pesos) porque contenerlo a medida que pasa el tiempo exige esfuerzos mayores en términos de comprar menos reservas y subir tasas", dijo a Reuters Roberto Gerreto, analista de Adcap Grupo Financiero.
* "Así, subas graduales del dólar van a permitir que no se atrase, facilitando la acumulación de reservas y no agregando estrés en las tasas. La clave será que no tenga ningún componente anunciado o sistemático, porque ello daría incentivos a dolarizar como ocurre cuando hay un 'crawling peg' formal", agregó.
* Mientras, el índice S&P Merval (.MERV) de la Bolsa de Buenos Aires trepó un 2,81%, apoyada por el avance de acciones del rubro financiero. El Merval cayó un 1,2% la semana previa.
* El peso mexicano bajaba hacia el cierre un 0,33%, a 16,9516 unidades por dólar, mientras que el índice S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) , integrado por las 35 acciones más líquidas del mercado, subió un ligero 0,06%, a 65.770,85
* "La moneda local enfrenta presiones por el fortalecimiento del dólar, el menor apetito por activos de mayor riesgo y las tensiones comerciales en Norteamérica, ante la cuarta revisión bilateral entre México y Estados Unidos, prevista para septiembre", dijo la correduría Monex.
* La inflación general de México avanzó en la primera quincena de agosto, aunque menos de lo previsto, mientras que el índice subyacente se desaceleró de forma inesperada.
* El real brasileño cedió un 0,23% a 5,1534 unidades por dólar, al tiempo que el referencial bursátil Bovespa (.BVSP) ganó un 0,6% a 172.055 puntos.
* El peso colombiano terminó con baja de un 0,67% a 3.057 unidades por dólar, alejándose de máximos de casi ocho años; mientras que en la bolsa el índice accionario MSCI COLCAP (.COLCAP) se valorizó un 2,09% a 2.510,68 puntos.
* El peso chileno , subió un 0,25%, en 912,50/912,80 unidades por dólar. En tanto, El índice principal de la Bolsa de Comercio de Santiago, el IPSA (.SPIPSA) , escaló un 1,76%, a 11.537,97 puntos.
* La moneda peruana, el sol , finalizó la jornada con una leve depreciación del 0,06% a 3,3460/3,3470 unidades por dólar. En tanto que, la Bolsa de Lima (.MXNUAMPESCPGPE) revirtió leves alzas y perdió un 0,18% a 1573,49 puntos.

items.title: Rendimiento de bonos EEUU cae mientras el Tesoro evalúa un cambio en su política de recompra
items.author: Karen Brettell
items.creator: Karen Brettell
items.summary: El rendimiento de los bonos de Estados Unidos caía el lunes, tras conocerse que el Departamento del Tesoro podría recurrir a su cuenta en efectivo para financiar un aumento de las recompras de deuda, mientras que los precios del petróleo retrocedieron.
items.body:
El rendimiento de los bonos de Estados Unidos caía el lunes, tras conocerse que el Departamento del Tesoro podría recurrir a su cuenta en efectivo para financiar un aumento de las recompras de deuda, mientras que los precios del petróleo retrocedieron.
* La CNBC dio a conocer la noticia menos de una semana después de que el secretario del Tesoro, Scott Bessent, anunciara que el Gobierno duplicará, como mínimo, sus recompras de deuda a largo plazo, una medida inesperada que avivó la especulación sobre un enfoque más intervencionista para frenar el aumento de los rendimientos.
* Esta medida supondría un cambio de rumbo, ya que las recompras están pensadas para ser neutras en términos de efectivo y se han financiado mediante emisiones, según explicó Molly Brooks, de TD Securities.
* Los operadores siguen sopesando las implicaciones, sobre todo porque la decisión se produjo al margen del calendario habitual de refinanciación del Tesoro. A algunos les preocupa que la medida sea contraproducente y socave la confianza en el enfoque "regular y predecible" de la agencia respecto a la emisión de deuda.
* "Si seguimos viendo este tipo de titulares que indican que podrían estar acelerando un poco las cosas, esa naturaleza regular y predecible podría, de hecho, aumentar la prima de plazo de los bonos del Tesoro a largo plazo", señaló Brooks.
* Bessent afirmó el lunes que Estados Unidos continuaría con su programa habitual de subastas de bonos del Tesoro.
* Esta situación complica aún más las perspectivas sobre las tasas de interés, ya que varias autoridades monetarias de la Reserva Federal han abogado por alzas en medio de una inflación persistentemente elevada.
* Los operadores de futuros sobre los fondos federales están valorando en un 44% la probabilidad de un alza de tasas en la reunión de política monetaria del banco central de septiembre, cifra que se eleva al 78% para diciembre.
* El rendimiento de los bonos a dos años , que suele evolucionar en línea con las expectativas de tasas, cotizaba estable en el 4,234%, y el de las notas referenciales a 10 años perdía 3,99 puntos básicos, al 4,698%.
* La curva de rendimiento entre la deuda a dos y 10 años se aplanaba a 46 puntos básicos.

items.title: 【米国市況】S&P500反落、半導体株に売り－円は小幅安で159円10銭台
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 24日の米株式市場でS&P500種株価指数は反落した。原油安というプラス材料を、半導体株の下げが打ち消した格好となった。ベッセント米財務長官がイランを世界経済から孤立させる計画を打ち出したことを受け、その中身を見極めたいとのムードが広がった。

フィラデルフィア半導体株指数は一時、前週末比4.1%下落した。米半導体大手エヌビディアが26日に発表する決算では、同社が圧倒的な優位を維持していることがあらためて示される見通し。しかし、エヌビディア株はこれで7営業日続落と、2022年以来の長期下落局面となった。

エヌビディアの大口顧客の一部は、AI半導体を搭載したサーバーを値上げするとの通知を受けた。週末のこの報道を受け、メモリー領域に特化した上場投資信託（ETF）は5.9%安で引けた。ナスダック100指数は1%安で終えた。

ベッセント氏は記者会見で、「われわれは世界各地に広がるイランの金融ネットワークに対し、経済的な猛攻撃を開始する」と表明。「イラン政権を経済的に窒息させるものだ」とし、イラン資金の洗浄に関与する場合、ドルへのアクセスを遮断すると述べた。

モルガン・スタンレー傘下Eトレード・ファイナンシャルのクリス・ラーキン氏は「米国による対イラン経済制裁の詳細や、米財務省による長期金利引き下げの取り組み、そして経済データが市場心理を大きく左右する可能性がある」と述べた。「エヌビディアをはじめとするハイテク企業の決算が、相場の勢いに大きな影響を与えそうだ」とも語った。

市場関係者は、ウォーシュ米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）議長が28日にワイオミング州ジャクソンホールで講演を行う際、根強いインフレにFRBがどう対応すべきかについて、自身の見解を明確にすることにも期待している。

クエスター・キャピタル・パートナーズのリチャード・ライル氏は「米財務省が先週、債券市場で異例の措置に踏み切ったことで、ウォーシュ議長は難しい立場に置かれている。積極的な情報発信を好まないようにみえる議長にとっては、なおさらだ」と述べた。

items.title: 9月の相次ぐ社債発行、消化への懸念は行き過ぎ－JPモルガン
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 投資適格級社債市場では、9月に社債発行が相次ぐ見通しだ。JPモルガン・アセット・マネジメントのポートフォリオマネジャー、ケルシー・ベロ氏は、ブルームバーグテレビジョンとのインタビューで、社債への旺盛な需要を踏まえれば、大量発行への懸念は行き過ぎの可能性があるとの見方を示した。

ベロ氏によると、9月の発行額については、1750億－2500億ドル（約27兆8400億－39兆7700億円）と幅広い予想が出ている。クレジットのポートフォリオマネジャーからは、発行額が2500億ドルに達しても「実際にはそれほど問題ではない」との声が聞かれるという。ただ、ベロ氏は、最終的な発行額を巡る不確実性が、市場関係者にとって事前の対応を難しくしていると指摘した。

市場では予想のばらつき自体が緊張の要因となっている。発行額予想の下限と上限には750億ドルの開きがあり、例年、社債発行が最も活発になる月の一つである9月を前に、ポートフォリオマネジャーはポジションを取りにくくなっている。

AIインフラ整備への支出を賄うため企業の借り入れが膨らむ中、社債発行は過去最速のペースが続いている。米国の優良企業による社債発行額は8月、3カ月連続で月間最高を更新した。

借り入れ急増の影響が表れる中、投資家は購入する債券やその価格を以前より厳しく選別するようになっている。データセンター事業の資金調達を目指す企業の中には、投資適格級の債券であっても、数十億ドルを調達するためにジャンク債投資家への依存を強めるところも出ている。

8月の社債発行額はすでに1570億ドルに達した。アルファベットによる250億ドルの起債に加え、アッヴィやアドバンスト・マイクロ・デバイセズ（AMD）による大型案件が発行額を押し上げた。

ベロ氏は「記録的な供給がある一方、需要も過去最高となっている」と述べた。こうした需給関係により、9月の大量発行は懸念されるほど大きな問題にはならない可能性があるという。

items.title: フーシ派、サウジのヤンブー沖で船舶攻撃と発表　国営海運バハリも被弾確認
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [カイロ　２４日　ロイター] -
items.body:
[カイロ　２４日　ロイター] - イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派は２４日、サウジアラビアの紅海沿岸にあるヤンブー港沖で船舶を攻撃したと発表した。同派の軍事報道官ヤヒヤ・サリー氏がテレビ演説で明らかにした。

サウジアラビアの国営海運会社バハリも同日、自社の船舶「アムザン」が紅海で攻撃を受けたと声明で明らかにした。

これに先立ち、英海事貿易機関（ＵＫＭＴＯ）は、ヤンブーの西方６３カイリの海域でタンカーが正体不明の飛翔体による攻撃を受けたと発表。ＵＫＭＴＯによると、乗組員全員の安全が確認されており、環境への影響も報告されていないという。

ヤンブーはサウジの主要な紅海沿岸の石油積み出し港で、１日あたり数百万バレルの石油が積み出されている。また、イランが封鎖しているホルムズ海峡を迂回するサウジ産原油の主要な輸出ルートとなっている。

items.title: Ives: Nvidia Earnings Could Be the Next Big Catalyst for AI Stocks
items.summary: Nvidia’s earnings report on Wednesday will likely serve as another reminder of the company’s commanding lead. Analysts estimate that revenue nearly doubled last quarter from a year earlier to $92 billion. That’s more money than any of its rivals get in a full year. But the flood of cash — with sky-high profit margins — only makes its turf more attractive. Meanwhile, some of Nvidia Corp.’s biggest customers have been told that the prices of servers containing its artificial intelligence chips are going up more than 15% in many cases, people familiar with the matter have said. Dan Ives, Partner and Senior Managing Director at Yorkville Ives, joins for a closer look. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Peso argentino toca nivel mínimo histórico
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: El peso argentino en el mercado interbancario anotó el lunes su nivel mínimo histórico, con aval del Gobierno, tras romper la barrera psicológica de las 1.500 unidades por dólar para la venta.
items.body:
El peso argentino en el mercado interbancario anotó el lunes su nivel mínimo histórico, con aval del Gobierno, tras romper la barrera psicológica de las 1.500 unidades por dólar para la venta.
Los analistas coinciden en que es saludable la tendencia ya que hay un consenso generalizado de cierto atraso cambiario, en un país donde el dólar se usa como ahorro ante el resguardo inflacionario.
Por su parte, las plazas de acciones y bonos del país sudamericano registraron mejoras dispares luego de finalizar en baja la semana previa ante la clara postura de prudencia por parte de los inversores.
En el segmento mayorista , el peso nacional se depreció un 0,66% al nivel mínimo histórico en 1.510 por cada dólar, luego de cerrar la semana anterior en 1.500 unidades.
"El dólar mayorista quebró la barrera de los 1.500 (pesos) porque contenerlo a medida que pasa el tiempo exige esfuerzos mayores en términos de comprar menos reservas y subir tasas", dijo a Reuters Roberto Geretto, analista de Adcap Grupo Financiero.
"Así, subas graduales del dólar van a permitir que no se atrase, facilitando la acumulación de reservas y no agregando estrés en las tasas. La clave será que no tenga ningún componente anunciado o sistemático, porque ello daría incentivos a dolarizar como ocurre cuando hay un 'crawling peg' formal", agregó.
El banco central (BCRA) argentino acumuló compras por 11 millones de dólares con el inicio de esta semana.
Hasta la semana anterior, en "agosto las compras (del BCRA) acumulan 466 millones de dólares, un promedio de 33 millones de dólares diarios que profundiza la desaceleración frente a julio (103 millones diarios) y queda por debajo de junio (68 millones de dólares) y mayo (137 millones de dólares)", explicó el agente de compensación y liquidación Cohen.
El índice S&P Merval (.MERV) de la Bolsa de Buenos Aires mejoró un firme 2,81% al cierre, apoyado por el avance de acciones del rubro financiero, contra una caída del 1,2% la semana previa.
"Pese al freno del deterioro reciente, el mercado mantiene la cautela ante la duda de si este movimiento constituye una mejora de fondo o un mero rebote técnico", expresó la consultora Wise Capital.
En tanto, los bonos soberanos en el segmento extrabursátil mejoraron apenas un 0,1% promedio, tras finalizar con un retroceso de 1,8% la semana pasada. El riesgo país, elaborado por el banco JP. Morgan, retrocedía algunos escalones hasta los 503 puntos básicos (2000 GMT).
El llamado Índice de Confianza en el Gobierno (ICG) de la Universidad Torcuato Di Tella subió 2,4 puntos porcentuales a 41,2% en agosto, marcando la mayor mejora mensual desde noviembre.
"La confianza en el Gobierno (del libertario Javier Milei) se mantiene elevada en relación a otras presidencias de este siglo", dijo el agente de liquidación y compensación Facimex. "La confianza en el Gobierno es clave por su correlación con los resultados electorales para el oficialismo", acotó.

items.title: 米国、対イラン追加制裁を発表へ－財務長官「経済的生命線全て断つ」
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： ベッセント米財務長官は24日、イランに対する新たな経済制裁措置を発表する見通しだ。約6カ月に及ぶ戦争の終結を目指し、米政府は軍事攻撃の威嚇から、徹底した経済制裁による圧力強化へと軸足を移す。

ベッセント氏は予定している会見で、イランを一段と効果的に孤立させる計画の詳細を明らかにする。米国は数十年にわたり広範な対イラン制裁を科してきたが、今回さらに強化する。具体的な内容は不明だが、中国やトルコ、インドなどイランの主要貿易相手国の一部に影響が及ぶ可能性がある。

アラブ首長国連邦（UAE）は先週、イランとの経済関係を全て断絶したと発表。湾岸の米同盟国によるこうした動きが、ワシントンの戦略を後押ししている。

ベッセント氏は英紙フィナンシャル・タイムズ（FT）への寄稿で、「世界は、イランが孤立するまで、この圧政政権を支えるあらゆる経済的生命線を断つことがわれわれの目的だと理解すべきだ」と述べた。

イラン経済は既に極めて厳しい状況にあり、米海軍による海上封鎖で重要な原油輸出が大幅に制限されている。

イランでは年間インフレ率が80％を超え、人口9000万人の国民への圧力が一段と強まっている。イラン通貨リアルは対ドルで過去最安値に沈む。トランプ米大統領が先週、イランへの経済圧力を強める計画を明らかにして以降、4.5％下落した。

イランはこれまでも制裁をしのいできた経緯があり、米国の今回の措置が新たな軍事攻撃を招く恐れもある。イランは、米国の制裁計画を支援する国には報復すると警告した。2月下旬の戦争開始以降、イランは湾岸の米同盟国に数千発のミサイルやドローンを撃ち込んでいる。

イラン最高安全保障委員会のレザイ事務局長は23日夜、「米国によるイラン国民への経済戦争に参加したり、これを支援したりする国の行為を戦争行為とみなす」とXへの投稿で表明。

その上で、「ホルムズ海峡からも、ペルシャ湾のどこからも、原油は一滴たりとも輸出されなくなる」と述べた。

items.title: Vladimir Putin offers to increase Russia's fertiliser exports to India
items.author: Archis Mohan
items.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin said Moscow was prepared to increase fertiliser supplies to India, while noting that bilateral trade grew in the first half of 2026 ...
items.body: Moscow is willing to increase its fertiliser supplies to India’s agricultural sector, Russian President Vladimir Putin said on Monday during his meeting with External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar.  The Russian President noted that bilateral trade between the two countries increased in the first half of 2026, after a decline in 2025. Jaishankar began his two-day official visit to Moscow on Sunday. He cochaired the 27th session of the India-Russia Inter-governmental Commission on trade, economic, scientific, technological and cultural cooperation, with Russia's First Deputy Prime Minister Denis Manturov. India is keen to host Putin for the Brics summit on September 12 and 13 in New Delhi. Prime Minister Narendra Modi is also slated to meet the Russian president in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan, during the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) Summit on August 31 and September 1. During the meeting, Putin said Manturov and Jaishankar have been working on increasing bilateral trade between the two countries, and must have discussed the key issues during their meeting, which are many. “One of these issues – not just fuel – is the supply of mineralisers (fertilisers). We are doing everything we can to resolve the issue for Indian farmers, for agriculture; we are increasing these exports and are prepared to continue doing so,” Putin said, according to Russian news agency Interfax.  “I am pleased to note that our trade has increased this year. It declined slightly last year, but it is growing this year,” he said. Russia has emerged as India’s biggest supplier of fertilisers, especially urea, in recent years. India’s imports of fertilisers from Russia increased by almost 40 per cent in 2025.  During Putin’s visit to New Delhi in December 2025, the two sides welcomed “steps to ensure long-term supply of fertilisers to India and discussed the potential establishment of joint ventures in this area.” At the meeting, Jaishankar said the increase in India-Russia bilateral trade from $13 billion in 2021 to $60 billion in 2025 has widened the trade imbalance, which has increased from $6.6 billion to over $50 billion in Russia’s favour. “Addressing this imbalance today is one of our foremost priorities,” Jaishankar said. The external affairs minister said progress on market access, removal of tariff and non-tariff barriers, strengthening payment mechanisms and stronger business-to-business engagement would be critical to addressing the imbalance and achieving the shared objective of $100 billion in bilateral trade by 2030. Manturov said bilateral trade with India would increase after the free trade agreement with the Eurasian Economic Union (EAEU) takes effect. “The preparation (for the trade deal) is in the active phase, and it is important to maintain the strong momentum at negotiations,” he said. Manturov said Russia and India increased bilateral trade by 8 per cent in the first half of 2026, stressing the need to increase and diversify trade. He said trade in agricultural produce, machine-building goods, metallurgy and forest products is expanding as well as traditional supplies of fuel and mineral fertilisers from Russia. “Imports from India include pharmaceuticals, agricultural products, industrial raw materials, equipment and components and light industry goods,” he said. The two sides also discussed civil nuclear cooperation.

items.title: S&P 500 y Nasdaq caen presionados por acciones tecnológicas; inversores analizan medidas sobre Irán
items.author: Saeed Azhar, Purvi Agarwal, Niket Nishant
items.creator: Saeed Azhar, Purvi Agarwal, Niket Nishant
items.summary: Los índices S&P 500 y Nasdaq descendieron el lunes, lastrados por las acciones tecnológicas, mientras los inversores sopesaban la nueva presión económica estadounidense contra Irán, a la espera esta semana de los resultados del gigante de la IA Nvidia y de un informe clave sobre la inflación.
items.body:
Los índices S&P 500 y Nasdaq descendieron el lunes, lastrados por las acciones tecnológicas, mientras los inversores sopesaban la nueva presión económica estadounidense contra Irán, a la espera esta semana de los resultados del gigante de la IA Nvidia y de un informe clave sobre la inflación.
* El Gobierno de Donald Trump anunció el lunes una posible ampliación de las sanciones a los países que mantienen relaciones comerciales con Irán, en lo que denominó un "Día D económico", pero no llegó a imponer sanciones.
* Las acciones de semiconductores cayeron, arrastrando al índice de semiconductores de Filadelfia (.SOX) . Nvidia (NVDA.O) bajó, al igual que Micron Technology (MU.O) y Broadcom (AVGO.O) , presionando al índice de tecnología de la información del S&P 500 (.SPLRCT) .
* El sentimiento hacia las empresas tecnológicas también se vio afectado por la creciente oposición política a los centros de datos de IA.
* El gobernador de Texas, Greg Abbott, lanzó una de las advertencias más contundentes hasta la fecha por parte de un republicano a la industria de la IA, afirmando que las firmas de centros de datos "cavaron su propia tumba" y merecen el rechazo que enfrentan tras no lograr el apoyo de la comunidad, informó Axios el domingo.
* Sin embargo, el índice financiero (.SPSY) subió, con JPMorgan Chase (JPM.N) y Visa (V.N) al alza. También contribuyeron a mantener a flote al índice Dow Jones.
* Según datos preliminares, el S&P 500 (.SPX) perdió 21,37 puntos, o un 0,28%, a 7.653,00 unidades. El Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) bajó 200,80 puntos, o un 0,77%, a 25.979,66 unidades; y el Promedio Industrial Dow Jones (.DJI) subió 141,67 puntos, o un 0,27%, a 53.418,68 unidades.
* Se espera que los resultados trimestrales del gigante de la IA, Nvidia, sean otro catalizador clave para los mercados. Cualquier señal de desaceleración del crecimiento podría reavivar la preocupación por las elevadas valoraciones.
* Los mercados también estarán atentos al informe de Gastos de Consumo Personal, el indicador de inflación preferido de la Fed, que se publicará el miércoles.

items.title: ＩＥＡ、戦略石油備蓄の2回目の放出「当面協議せず」＝事務局長
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Nora Buli

[スタバンゲル（ノルウェー）　２４日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Nora Buli

[スタバンゲル（ノルウェー）　２４日　ロイター] - 国際エネルギー機関（ＩＥＡ）のビロル事務局長は２１日、戦略石油備蓄の追加放出については現時点で協議していないとロイターに述べた。

ビロル氏はノルウェーで開かれたエネルギー会議の合間に、ＩＥＡが戦略石油備蓄の２回目の放出について検討しているかとの質問に対し、「当面は検討していない」と言及。ＩＥＡは市場を「非常に注意深く」注視し続けており、３月に行った４億バレルの放出後も戦略備蓄の８０％が残っていると明らかにした。

天然ガスに関しては、透明性プラットフォーム「ＡＧＳＩ」のデータで欧州の現在のガス備蓄水準が約６２％にとどまっていることに懸念を表明。「備蓄は過去の平均を下回っており、われわれは依然として中東からのガス供給に期待している。同時に欧州はロシア産ガスの輸入停止を約束している」とし、「欧州に厳しい冬が訪れた場合、いくつかの課題に直面する可能性がある」と述べた。

欧州連合（ＥＵ）は１２月１日までに備蓄率を８０％まで引き上げることを目標としている。

items.title: Alibaba Drops, SoftBank Bond Sale, Bitcoin Rally | Stock Movers
items.summary:
Today's biggest winners and losers in the stock market.

On this episode of Stock Movers:

- Alibaba (BABA) is tumbling after announcing a plan to raise about HK$80 billion ($10.2 billion) from a share sale. The share placement is expected to dilute earnings and hurt stock performance in the near term, analysts said. Meanwhile, the fundraising will help drive AI-led growth and the impact on earnings will be limited if the company can improve AI payoffs, they added. The tech and chip sectors are seeing a broader selloff globally.

- SoftBank (SFTBY) is moving on news it plans a record ¥1 trillion retail bond sale to raise funds for its investment commitments to OpenAI.

- Bitcoin (BTC) is continuing its rally. Spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds had their strongest weekly inflow in 10 months last week as the original cryptocurrency surged. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: トランプ氏、対カナダ自動車・鉄鋼関税を50％へ　来年1月発動
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ワシントン ２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ワシントン ２４日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２４日、２０２７年１月１日から、カナダ産の自動車やトラック、自動車部品、鉄鋼に対する関税を５０％に引き上げると表明した。

トランプ大統領は自身の交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」に、「米国で製造すれば関税はゼロだ」とした上で、「貿易面でもその他の面でも、カナダは世界で最も扱いにくい国の一つだ。彼らは当然の権利があるかのように振る舞うが、われわれはカナダを必要としていない。カナダこそが米国を必要としているのだ」と投稿した。

さらに、通商交渉決裂後にカナダ当局者らが行った一連の発言に言及し、カナダ側が「従わない」のであれば、カナダにとって結果はさらに悪化するとの認識を示した。

米国は２２日、カナダとの通商交渉が決裂したことを受け、約２００億ドル相当のカナダ製品に対する５０％の追加関税を発動した。

交渉では、カナダ産の自動車・小型トラックに対する最高関税率を２５％から１５％に、アルミニウムと鉄鋼への関税を５０％から２５％にそれぞれ引き下げる見通しとなっていた。しかし、中・大型トラックに対する米関税の引き下げが争点となり、合意に至らなかったという。

カナダのカーニー首相は報復措置として、９月８日から米国産の鉄鋼や電子機器などに関税を課す方針を表明した。

カーニー氏は２４日、トランプ大統領による今回の新たな関税措置の表明について「米国が何らかの報復措置を取ることは驚きではない」と述べた。先週、交渉が決裂したが、米国と互恵的な合意は可能だとし、「米国がカナダの産業に対して正しい姿勢を持てば、カナダは交渉のテーブルに戻る」と述べた。

米自動車産業はカナダやメキシコとのサプライチェーン統合が進んでおり、関税措置は内容次第で米国内の自動車生産に深刻な影響を及ぼす可能性がある。

カナダ自動車部品製造業者協会（ＡＰＭＡ）のフラビオ・ボルペ会長は、米国が検討する関税について「その負担は米国の自動車組立メーカーが負うことになる。こうした部品がなければ、全米の自動車組立工場は操業停止に追い込まれるだろう」と警鐘を鳴らした。

こうした中、バンス副大統領はメーン州での演説で、カナダとの交渉は継続しており、米国は貿易における公平性を求めていくと言明。「カナダは土壇場で理不尽な要求を次々と突きつけてきた」と非難した上で、「合意は必要だが、カナダ首相には明確なメッセージを送る必要がある。メーン州の人々を、そして米国を食い物にするのはやめてもらいたい。われわれは貿易政策において公平さを求める」と述べた。

ベセント米財務長官も同日、記者団に対し、トランプ大統領はカナダに交渉のテーブルに戻り、誠意を持って交渉に臨むことを望んでいると語った。

主要自動車メーカーはトランプ大統領の発表について直ちにはコメントしていない。

トランプ大統領の警告を受け、２４日の米株式市場で自動車株は大きく下落した。フォードは３．６％安、ステランティスは４．２％安、ゼネラル・モーターズ（ＧＭ）は１．６％安となった。ニューヨーク市場でトヨタ自動車は１．５％安、ホンダは２．１％安となった。

items.title: As US border reopens to Mexican cattle, concerns persist over screwworm spread
items.author: Cassandra Garrison, Leah Douglas
items.creator: Cassandra Garrison, Leah Douglas
items.summary: Mexico is bolstering its screwworm containment campaign in northern border states where recent cases have been detected, heightening scrutiny of livestock exports as cross-border trade resumed on Monday under a phased U.S. reopening.
items.body:
Mexico is bolstering its screwworm containment campaign in northern border states where recent cases have been detected, heightening scrutiny of livestock exports as cross-border trade resumed on Monday under a phased U.S. reopening.
The reopening marks the first easing of a U.S. ban imposed more than a year ago to keep out the flesh-eating pest, as imports [USN:FWN43Q0OT TEXT:"resumed"] initially through Arizona .
The plan has drawn criticism from some U.S. cattle groups and state officials who argue that resuming imports could increase screwworm risks even as the parasite continues to spread in northern Mexico and has already been detected in Texas and New Mexico.
Mexican Agriculture Minister Columba Lopez said authorities would reinforce the dispersal of sterile flies in Sonora and Chihuahua, a key eradication strategy aimed at preventing the parasite from reproducing.
Agriculture Secretary Brooke Rollins told reporters on Monday that the USDA feels it has "taken every step to protect the American (cattle) herd and the American consumer, and so now we can slowly begin to reopen the ports."
The USDA plans to open two more New Mexico ports, one in 30 days and another in 60 days, Rollins said. "We don't plan to open any Texas ports anytime soon just because that is where the real activity is," Rollins said.
The USDA has identified 46 cases of screwworm in New Mexico and Texas, with two currently active, according to the agency's website.
NEW CASES IN MEXICO A USDA website on Monday said it reopened the Douglas, Arizona, port to cattle imports from Mexico "guided by overlapping safeguards and a science-based import protocol" agreed upon by the two countries. The USDA will next evaluate the reopening of ports in Santa Teresa and Columbus, New Mexico, to cattle, bison, and horses.
"The opening of ports may be paused if USDA identifies increased risk in Sonora or Chihuahua via post-opening audits or other observations/information," the site said.
The reopening will begin with exports of 700 head of cattle per day during the first week, increasing to 900 per day in the second week and gradually rising to around 1,300 per day, according to Mexico’s National Confederation of Livestock Organizations (CNOG).
If additional Chihuahua border crossings are reopened in the fourth quarter, Mexico could export up to 200,000 head of cattle in 2026, with an estimated value of about $420 million at U.S. market prices, CNOG said. Its base scenario for 2027 projects exports of 1.09 million head of cattle, valued at roughly $2.1 billion in the U.S. market.
Chihuahua, one of Mexico's most important cattle-exporting states, has reported 183 confirmed screwworm cases since detecting its first case in July, while neighboring Sonora state has reported two confirmed cases after announcing its first detection last week. Sonora has activated emergency surveillance and containment protocols, while Chihuahua has intensified inspections, livestock movement controls and treatment campaigns to prevent further spread.
The sterile insect technique works by releasing millions of sterilized screwworm flies that mate with wild females but produce no offspring, gradually driving down the pest population. Mexico recently opened a sterile-fly production plant in Chiapas, while the U.S. is building its own production facility in Texas, expected to be completed by the [USN:L6N4470WS TEXT:"spring of 2027"].
Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum referred to the sterile-fly technique as a "modern" and "effective" way to fight screwworm.
"That allows us to open the border," Sheinbaum said in her daily press conference.
